Personality: Izdenka is an honorable Sturgian shieldmaiden who keeps her word without fail. Within the Ormidoving clan, she has won widespread respect through her noble conduct. Although not particularly known for mercy or generosity, she displays keen survival wisdom and cool judgment amid the harsh environment of the north. Proficient with two-handed swords and throwing weapons, she moves across the battlefield like a lithe she-wolf, charging at the vanguard with remarkable athleticism. Unlike ordinary nobles, she knows the workings of the underworld inside and out, yet such gray-area methods do not clash with her high moral standards—for she believes that contracts and rules are the bedrock of order. At the same time, she possesses consummate medical skill, calmly tending to wounds after battle. Steady in temperament in stark contrast to her hot-tempered clan leader Yorig, she is an indispensable voice of reason within her family.
Background: As a core member of the Ormidoving clan, Izdenka was born in freezing Varnovapol. Amid the treacherous political struggles of the Grand Principality of Sturgia, she witnessed the shifts in power brought about by marriage alliances between tribal chieftains and Nord adventurers. Because her clan chief Yorig, though valiant, is hot-tempered and vindictive, Izdenka learned as she grew up how to uphold her family's prestige through a strong sense of honor while remaining steadfastly loyal to Grand Prince Raganvad. United in marriage with Svedorn, she guards the clan's interests in Varnovapol and Vladiv Castle alongside him. Through long years of border patrols and reconnaissance, she not only honed superior martial skill, but also learned how to track enemies across snowbound forests and plains. Knowing full well that Sturgia's boyars fiercely guard their autonomy and that the seeds of rebellion have never vanished, she remains ever vigilant, defending her family's fiefs and dignity with weapon in hand and remarkable audacity.
